item.title: Restoration and Healing
item.description:
I haven’t written in a bit. When I started this year I made a stubborn effort to go into full restoration in Christ by the end of the year. Restoration I guess can be healing. Healing of the mind body and soul.

I never expected to come so far this year. Let alone when I began this blog. I left a church vowed to never go to one again. Found a new one.
